name: dsh-onebot-companion
description: One DSH plugin that gives a dsh-onebot-qq channel its manners back: outbound silence guard, session-adoption guard, per-turn behaviour rules, inbound coalescing plus outbound burst delivery, message time/gap stamps, a persona layer with mood, proactive talk and style learning, QQ share-card restoration, native faces, voice, sleep gate and a gated set of social actions (poke / react / like / friend-request approval / intimate relations / self profile).
author: xfgil
